p: wise man's heart is at his: So that he does all things well and justly, where as the fool does the contrary.
saith to every one that he: By his doings he betrays himself.
spirit of the ruler riseth against: If your superior is angry with you, be discrete and not moved.
error which proceedeth from the ruler: Meaning that it is an evil thing when they who are in authority fail and do not do their duty.
rich sit in low place: They who are rich in wisdom and virtue.
strength: Without wisdom, whatever a man takes in hand, turns to his own hurt.
city: The ignorance and beastliness of the wicked is such that they know not common things, and yet will discuss high matters.
child: That is, without wisdom and counsel.
eat in the morning: Are given to their lusts and pleasures.
of nobles: Meaning, when he is noble for virtue and wisdom and with the gifts of God.
bird of the air shall carry: You cannot work evil so secretly that it will not be known.
